_deploymentNotes: FSI Agent Governance Framework — Purview DLP Policy Template

name: fsi-agentgov-mime-upload-restrictions
displayName: FSI Agent Governance - MIME Type Upload Restrictions
description: Purview DLP policy restricting executable and script file uploads in Power Platform environments. Supports compliance with FINRA 4511 and SEC 17a-4 record-keeping requirements by helping prevent unauthorized file type uploads. Part of the FSI Agent Governance Framework, Control 1.25 — MIME Type Restrictions. Implementation requires validation against organization-specific requirements.
